get.description:
Returns the organization's interviews for the mode of the API key, newest first, in
cursor-paginated pages. Every filter is optional: a filter sent with an empty value is
treated as not provided, and the unfiltered list is returned.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at. Strict ISO 8601 date-time, UTC (Z) or a numeric offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. An invalid or non-ISO-8601 value answers 400 validation_failed.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at. Strict ISO 8601 date-time, UTC (Z) or a numeric offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. An invalid or non-ISO-8601 value answers 400 validation_failed.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Exact match on the external_id supplied as candidate.external_id when the interview was created. An integer from 1 to 9007199254740991; any other value answers 400 validation_failed. An empty value is ignored.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Exact, case-sensitive match on the source supplied as candidate.source when the interview was created. At most 180 characters; a longer value answers 400 validation_failed. An empty value is ignored.

post.description:
Re-queues one delivery for immediate re-send. Allowed only from a terminal state:
`delivered`, `failed_permanent` or `dead`.

email.description: Valid email address, at most 255 characters.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code: two lowercase letters, for example `it`.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value pairs (≤ 20 keys, key ≤ 40 chars, value ≤ 500 chars).

exit_redirect_url.description: Must be an https URL of at most 2048 characters.

CreateInterviewRequest.title: CreateInterviewRequest

hosted_url.description: Always `null` on a read: the hosted interview URL is returned only together with a freshly issued session token.

recording_ready.description: `true` when an audio recording of the interview is available. Audio only: video is never exposed.

external_id.description: The calling system's own numeric identifier for this candidate, as supplied when the interview was created; `null` when none was given.

source.description: The calling system the candidate came from, as supplied when the interview was created; `null` when none was given.

version.description: The version of the framework the project is pinned to.

mode.description: The mode of the API key making the request, not a property of the organization: the same organization answers `live` through a live key and `test` through a test key.
